qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Embedded relationships in French public sector and defense, but sub-hurdle capital efficiency (RoCE 6.7-7.5% vs 12% hurdle) and single-digit operating margins (7-9%) prove lack of an economic moat. Highly vulnerable to IT services commoditization and public sector budget austerity.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Moat & Pricing Power, REJECT). Undifferentiated French IT services provider with sub-hurdle capital efficiency (RoCE 6.7-7.5% vs 12% requirement) and thin operating margins (~8%). Heavy reliance on price-sensitive French public-sector RFPs leaves zero pricing power above inflation.
qualitative.evidence: Operating margin on business activity was 8.1% (2021), 8.9% (2022), 9.4% (2023), and 9.8% (2024), with standard reported operating margins of 7.5%-8.9%. Reported RoCE was 6.7% in 2021 and 7.5% in 2022, structurally failing the 12% ROIC threshold. Growth has been heavily reliant on M&A rollups (CS Group, Ordina) while core organic growth is sluggish. Public-sector customer concentration exposes the business to sovereign procurement spending freezes and billable-hour deflation from AI tooling.
